purpose: REQUIRED-CONFIGURATION SPECIFICATION for the credentialless release publication path (GitHub OIDC Trusted Publishing) and for the CI-issued cryptographic attestation of release artifacts. This file is NOT evidence of configuration and NOT evidence of publication: it states the security boundary and the exact external configuration that MUST exist before any publication may ever run. It deliberately separates repository structural evidence from externally verified live configuration.

repository_structural_evidence.note: What this repository version-controls and its non-privileged CI proves: the fail-closed privileged release workflow, the release evidence builder/verifier tooling, the reproducible-build/SBOM/manifest evidence bundle, and green non-privileged validation jobs.
repository_structural_evidence.live_publication_dependency: external PyPI trusted-publisher configuration and an explicitly authorized release run

external_live_configuration_evidence.note: Facts verifiable ONLY from live GitHub/PyPI configuration and an authorized release execution. The repository never fabricates them.
external_live_configuration_evidence.note_details: PyPI Trusted Publishing for the dbf-anonymizer project has NOT been externally configured or live-verified. The publication job is fail-closed and cannot run until the authoritative gate repository variable is set AND the PyPI project owner completes the Trusted Publisher configuration.

publication.ref_guard: refs/heads/main or refs/tags/* only, verified before any checkout; every other ref is refused
publication.fail_closed_note: The publication job condition is vars.DBF_PYPI_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_ENABLED == 'true'. While the variable is unset the job cannot run and nothing is published; the gate deliberately follows the fail-closed pattern established for the trusted VFP9 runner lane (REQ-P7-006).
publication.pre_publication_verification: The publication job re-runs tools/verify_release_evidence.py against the downloaded evidence bundle and refuses to publish on any mismatch (fail-closed).
external_configuration_required: The PyPI project owner must configure the dbf-anonymizer project's Trusted Publisher on PyPI (owner/repository/workflow filename/environment) before any publication can succeed.
The repository owner must set the repository variable DBF_PYPI_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_ENABLED to 'true' only after the PyPI-side configuration is live.

attestation.note: GitHub artifact attestations are cryptographically verifiable, CI-issued build provenance statements signed through GitHub's OIDC/Sigstore infrastructure. No private signing key exists: no signing key is created, stored, or read anywhere in this repository, and the attestation job can never execute for pull_request events.

integrity.note: Every artifact and the SBOM carry SHA-256 values recorded in the deterministic evidence manifest; the verifier recomputes them and fails closed on any tampering.

invariants: no publication credential, token, or id-token authority may ever be exposed to pull_request execution
the privileged release workflow must never contain a pull_request, pull_request_target or workflow_run trigger
any job holding id-token: write or attestations: write must live exclusively in the privileged release workflow and must remain SHA-pinned and minimally permissioned
the publication job is fail-closed: it runs only from an authorized release context (release published or a main/tag dispatch) AND only when the authoritative gate repository variable equals 'true'
the repository never claims PyPI Trusted Publishing is configured; that platform fact stays external and must be verified live before publication
no private signing key exists; cryptographic authenticity comes from CI-issued GitHub artifact attestations, and integrity comes from the SHA-256 hashed evidence manifest
